ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the growing concern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the extension of the provider pause and the involvement of the U.S. Senate.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the scope of the fraud and the efforts to combat it.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the state addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for increased scrutiny and oversight of Medicaid providers to prevent fraud.

ideas.title: White House Teleprompter Operator Insider Trading
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of insider trading against the White House teleprompter operator, including the specifics of the trades made.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the validity of the allegations and the potential implications for the White House.
questions: What trades did the teleprompter operator make?
How did they have access to non-public information?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises questions about the integrity of White House staff and the potential for abuse of power.
